title: Code of practice for handling of electrostatic sensitive devices
clause_1_scope: 1.1 This code of practice gives the precautions which apply to the storage, transport, handling and testing of all kinds of static-sensitive devices, circuits and assemblies.
clause_3_terminology: Code of practice for handling of electrostatic sensitive devices

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
